audit.whatIsWrong: The root is attributed to the Mantra-empowered Q in five places, and Hallowed Mist is described as breaking line of sight in six.
audit.why: Focused Resolve (W) is the tether and the root, on a flat 12s, and its Mantra bonus heals Karma while extending it - Inner Flame's Mantra bonus is a delayed ground cataclysm with no root at all. Separately, Hallowed Mist grants untargetability to enemies outside it, not vision denial: it hard-answers a targeted tether like Focused Resolve, but it does not stop a Mantra-Q cataclysm already placed under your feet. Teaching 'breaks line of sight' invites a player to stand in fog and eat the one spell the fog does not stop.
audit.corrected: Root reattributed to Focused Resolve throughout; mist described as untargetability rather than line-of-sight, with the Mantra-Q ground cataclysm called out as the exception.

audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Gwen levels 3 and 4-5, gave Karma level 6, and gave Gwen two items - four stages against the prose.
audit.why: whys[2] and whys[3] both describe 3 and 4-5 as evening out, whys[4] says level 6 flips to Gwen, and whys[6] calls the late game a coin-flip on catching her Inspire down.
audit.corrected: Karma / Karma / Skill / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Skill.
sources: existing whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], whys[6] prose

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns despite the page telling you to catch her 'E shield on cooldown'.
audit.why: Inspire is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 - it is almost always up, which is precisely why 'catch her E down' is a much narrower plan than the page implies. Focused Resolve is a flat 12s and Mantra 40/38/36/34, and Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's cooldown every time she lands a damaging ability, so poking you actually accelerates her ult.
audit.corrected: late, whys[6] and wants.foe[2] now carry the numbers and the Gathering Fire consequence.

edits.before: Karma owns the first few levels — her Q outranges everything you have, she already has Mantra from level 1 so the empowered RQ root-and-tether is live, and you have no Hallowed Mist yet to break line of sight, so eat the minimum poke and farm with the tip of your Q rather than walking up. Last-hit at max range and respect that her RQ root can set up a jungle gank.
edits.after: Karma owns the first few levels — Inner Flame outranges everything you have, she has Mantra from level 1, and her Focused Resolve tether roots you on a flat 12s, so eat the minimum poke and farm with the tip of your Q rather than walking up. Do not E-trade at 1-3; her Q chips you faster than A Thousand Cuts heals it back, and she just Inspire-shields and walks away. Last-hit at max range and respect that a landed Focused Resolve root can set up a jungle gank you cannot dash out of.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still a poke-soak — you're a melee with no untargetability and her Q keeps you honest — but at 6 the lane evens out. With Needlework, your full Q-W-E kit, and Hallowed Mist ranked, you can E in and drop W to break line of sight so her Q and RQ poke lose their target, then Snip Snip! her squishy bar. Sidestep the root, body-block it with minions, or eat it inside your Mist — once you're on her she has no escape but the move speed off her E.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still a poke-soak — you are a melee with no untargetability and her Q keeps you honest — but at 6 the lane evens out. With Needlework and Hallowed Mist ranked, E in and drop W: she cannot target you from outside the fog, which hard-answers her Focused Resolve tether. The fog is untargetability, not vision — a Mantra-Q cataclysm under your feet still lands. Sidestep the tether or body-block it; once you are on her she has only Inspire's move speed.

The catch is range and disengage: her empowered RE shield-bomb and Mantra poke let her shield her team and slip away, so you only win when you catch her E shield on cooldown. Force the all-in through your Mist in the side lane before she can kite you in a 5v5 — she scales as a teamfight enchanter, you scale as a 1v1 duelist.

notes: Two real mechanical errors here, both repeated. (1) The page credits the root to 'RQ' - the empowered Q - five times ('her RQ root-and-tether', 'Mantra her Q into the RQ root'). Riot's text: Inner Flame is a ball of spirit energy that explodes, and its Mantra bonus is a delayed cataclysm; the ROOT is Focused Resolve (W), a targeted tether whose Mantra bonus extends the root AND heals her. A Gwen dodging the wrong spell gets rooted anyway. Corrected everywhere. (2) The page says Hallowed Mist 'breaks line of sight' six times. It does not - Riot's text is that Gwen can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. Karma keeps vision of you the whole time; what she loses is the ability to target you from outside. That distinction matters because Focused Resolve is a targeted tether, so the mist is a hard answer to it, while a Mantra-Q cataclysm placed on the ground still lands on you inside the fog. Also: Focused Resolve's Mantra heal means Grievous Wounds has a role, and no cooldowns existed - Focused Resolve is a flat 12s, Inner Flame 9s, Inspire 10s, Mantra 40s. The full layer called Karma 'he' 24 times against 3 'she'.
